name: voc-hub-autoresolve
description: Closes one self-assigned VoC Hub record per run: selects the oldest unresolved VoC whose initial_jira_owner matches VOC_ASSIGNEE_EMAIL, drafts a reply from the customer's message, and sends it via the managed integration API with status=resolved. No per-run human approval — scope is narrowed instead (single VoC, Jira-assignee-matched only) to bound the risk.
